errors.evidence: The description omits the first bar corresponding to the x-axis category "0~0.2", which has a value of 0.
The five categories shown on the x-axis are "0~0.2", "0.2~0.4", "0.4~0.6", "0.6~0.8", and "0.8~1.0". The description omits the first category and incorrectly lists "1.0" as a separate category.
The bar for the category "0.6~0.8" has an exact value of 35, not 37.

errors.evidence: This is described as the 'first bar', but it is the second bar on the x-axis. The first bar corresponds to the category '0~0.2'.
The bar for the category "0.2~0.4" has a value of 8, not approximately 10.
The bar for the category "0.4~0.6" has a value of 16, not approximately 20.
This approximation is used for the bar with value 35 ("0.6~0.8" category). Approximating 35 as 40 is a significant overestimation.
